finding: The ledger closes for any partner, but the device energy is F . v_rel in the partner frame. With the canon Sun partner a 0.9 MN lift near Earth swings by about +/-240 GJ in 9 s (~27 GW peak, vs 40 MW for the lift itself) depending on local time, ~1,000x the 0.18 GJ of the lift itself. Run in reverse it mines Earth's orbital energy, which collides in practice with the §7.3 no-free-work firewall. A shuttle-scale W2 needs the partner to be the local dominant body (or the source of the local gravitational field).
discriminating_observable: device energy draw vs relative velocity to candidate partners: a Sun partner shows a time-of-day swing of +/-27 GW at 0.9 MN; a local partner shows only F . v_local
